paper.title_en: The ZTF Variability Archive (ZVAR): Initial Data Release (DR1)
paper.abstract_en: The Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) has observed the northern sky observable from Palomar Observatory since March 2018, accumulating a median of a thousand photometric measurements across $gri$ for each of more than a billion sources. Among these billions of objects are millions of periodically variable stars, active galactic nuclei, stellar remnants, and substellar objects. We describe the initial data release (DR1) of the ZTF Variability Archive (ZVAR) which provides image difference forced photometry, candidate periods, and variability metrics for approximately 1.3 billion sources in ZTF having an identification in Pan-STARRS1 DR1 (PS1). The data cover the 5.37 year interval between March 2018 and July 2023. ZVAR is sensitive to periods between 5 minutes and 2.7 years. We also describe tools for accessing the ZVAR data.
